exposure: intracaesarean insertion of IUCD (cu-t380A and cu-t375)
outcome: occurrence of complications (bleeding, missing strings, infection, pregnancy, expulsion)
cohort: The study included 400 patients delivering by caesarean section at Darbhanga Medical College & Hospital.
finding: Among 400 patients receiving immediate post-placental intracaesarean IUCD insertion, the study found 22 expulsions, 38 cases of bleeding, 65 cases of missing strings, 5 infections, and 0 pregnancies over 6 months, concluding that expulsion rates may be higher than with interval insertion.
